name: CoA Custom races: CoA.CustomRaces.Enable = 0 refuses new characters of the added races
contract: With CoA.CustomRaces.Enable = 0 the account hook refuses CMSG_CHAR_CREATE for every race outside the stock races 1-8, 10 and 11, answering CHAR_CREATE_DISABLED; the stock races are created as before.
The scenario sets custom_races false, which applies Enable = 0 for this case only and restores the configured value afterwards.

Skeleton (26) and Horde Pandaren (20) are Horde, so the Orc actor's account may hold them on a PvP realm; coa-custom-races-male-only creates the same male Skeleton and coa-custom-races-quests a Horde Pandaren when the races are enabled.
Native SMSG_CHAR_CREATE answers are observed; the client's character screen is not rendered.

steps.label: CONTROL: a stock Orc is still created
DISCRIMINATING: a male Skeleton is refused
DISCRIMINATING: a Horde Pandaren is refused
